data.name: Schedule Store Simulator
data.detailed_description:
The Drug Enforcement Administration

You're a small-time drug dealer arriving in Tokyo with no cash, no product, and no connections. Build your empire from scratch in this gritty west-coast city—then let it run itself.

This is an idle strategy game where your criminal empire grows even when you're offline. Set up automated production chains, assign dealers, and optimize logistics—then step back and watch the profits roll in.

Produce a variety of drugs, each with its own unique production process. Discover rare recipes to unlock new variants with special effects and higher street value.

Expand your reach across Tokyo . Walk, skate, or drive to seed new zones, or delegate distribution to hired dealers who work while you plan your next move.

Acquire properties, hire employees, and partner with suppliers to build a fully automated system—from raw materials to street-level sales. Your empire keeps growing while you focus on upgrades, strategy, and expansion.

But power comes at a price. Law enforcement tightens its grip, and rival cartels won’t hesitate to strike. Invest in defenses and stay one step ahead.

Idle doesn’t mean passive. Every decision you make shapes the future of your empire—even when you're not watching.
